integrity: The new range n=42..57 was recomputed with exact integer arithmetic. The decisive row 120 was cross-checked by a separate LCM-state dynamic program, and the implementation reproduces the published n=41 row-90 certificate.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact result only: it identifies the first n with minimum prefix defect exactly 2 but does not classify all n=57 optimizers or later defect behavior. The source ancillary archive was not independently retrieved; the manuscript explicitly scopes its certified defect data to claims through n=41.
title: The first prefix-defect-two optimum in Pascal-row LCM minimization
